'''Gosular''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Gosular appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
